mapper.select: SELECT advance.advance_id FROM hr_employee_advance advance JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.tenant_id = advance.tenant_id AND instance.instance_id = advance.instance_id AND instance.deleted = 0 WHERE advance.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessType')) = 'HR_ADVANCE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessId')) = CAST(advance.advance_id AS CHAR) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND task.instance_id = instance.instance_id AND task.task_id = #{taskId} AND task.assignee = #{userId} AND task.proxy_user_id IS NULL AND task.status = 'TODO' AND instance.status = 'RUNNING' AND advance.approval_status = 'SUBMITTED') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_task_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND history.instance_id = instance.instance_id AND history.task_id = #{taskId} AND history.operator_id = #{userId} AND history.on_behalf_of_user_id IS NULL AND ((history.action = 'APPROVE' AND history.task_type = 'APPROVAL') OR (history.action = 'REJECT' AND history.task_type = 'REJECT') OR (history.action IN ('COUNTERSIGN_APPROVE', 'COUNTERSIGN_REJECT') AND history.task_type = 'OR_SIGN'))))
SELECT status FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_final_settlement settlement JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.tenant_id = settlement.tenant_id AND employee.id = settlement.employee_id WHERE settlement.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND settlement.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND settlement.settlement_kind = 'NORMAL' AND settlement.superseded_flag = 0 AND settlement.relieving_date >= employee.hire_date AND (settlement.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PAID', 'CLOSED') OR settlement.approval_status = 'SUBMITTED')

SELECT user_row.user_id FROM sys_dept department JOIN sys_user user_row ON user_row.tenant_id = department.tenant_id AND (CAST(user_row.user_id AS CHAR) = TRIM(department.leader) OR user_row.user_name = TRIM(department.leader) OR user_row.nick_name = TRIM(department.leader)) WHERE department.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND department.dept_id = #{departmentId} AND department.deleted = 0 AND department.status = '0' AND department.leader IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(department.leader) != '' AND user_row.deleted = 0 AND user_row.status = '0' ORDER BY user_row.user_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN paid_time IS NOT NULL THEN outstanding_amount WHEN approval_status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED') THEN advance_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM hr_employee_advance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND advance_id != #{excludedId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee_advance advance JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.tenant_id = advance.tenant_id AND instance.instance_id = advance.instance_id AND instance.deleted = 0 WHERE advance.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND advance.advance_id = #{advanceId} AND instance.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND instance.status = #{status} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessType')) = 'HR_ADVANCE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessId')) = CAST(#{advanceId} AS CHAR) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_task_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND history.instance_id = instance.instance_id AND history.operator_id = #{actor} AND history.operator_id != instance.start_user_id AND history.on_behalf_of_user_id IS NULL AND ((#{status} = 'PASSED' AND history.action = 'COUNTERSIGN_APPROVE' AND history.task_type = 'OR_SIGN') OR (#{status} = 'REJECTED' AND ((history.action = 'REJECT' AND history.task_type = 'REJECT') OR (history.action = 'COUNTERSIGN_REJECT' AND history.task_type = 'OR_SIGN')))))
SELECT id AS payment_id, user_id, source_biz_type, source_biz_id, amount, status, deleted FROM biz_payment_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{paymentId}

SELECT payload_json FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND aggregate_type = 'cloudflow-oa' AND aggregate_id = #{paymentId} AND event_type = 'HR_ADVANCE_PAYMENT_PAID'
